payload.abstract: The International Cardiac Arrest REsearch consortium (I-CARE) Database includes baseline clinical information and continuous electroencephalogram (EEG) and electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings from comatose patients following cardiac arrest. The patients were admitted to an intensive care unit (ICU) in one of seven academic hospitals in the U.S. and Europe and monitored for several hours to several days. The long-term neurological function of the patients was determined using the Cerebral Performance Category scale.
